summary: One of the chain's three links holds over this bundle's material. All 18 rendered prompts carry the pinned template block and none has an unfilled placeholder, and the template itself is pinned by digest - that is link one. Link two does not hold: the rendered prompts name their input by relative path and not by digest, so nothing in the bytes ties a prompt to the packet it was rendered against, which ./rechecked demonstrates by finding two shapes each standing for three different packets. Link three has nothing to check, because no cell ran and there is no public cell summary.
establishes: The template-to-prompt link and the no-unfilled-placeholder precondition, over a real rendering; and, through ./rechecked, that the checker refuses to call a normalisation sound when it can stand for more than one input.
residual: Previously recorded here as 'two of the three links hold'. That was wrong in the same way the unenforced check was: the prompt-to-input link was assumed from the normalisation rather than established from the bytes. The correction is the reason ./rechecked exists.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
